blurb:
That name alone should tell you something. Simon Kitty Paws is a two-year-old domestic shorthair with a name that sounds like he introduced himself and nobody argued with it. He's 13 pounds, which means he's got some size to him — not chunky, just substantial. The kind of cat that takes up the whole armrest when he decides it's his.

He's litter box trained and fully vetted — vaccinated, microchipped, neutered, and flea-treated. Everything's already handled. His compatibility with other pets and kids is unknown since he came in without much history, but the shelter does walk-in visits so you can bring your crew and see how introductions go before you commit.

If you're looking for a cat with a little personality baked into his name and probably the rest of him too, Simon Kitty Paws is worth a stop. Lewisville Animal Services is on College Pkwy in Lewisville. Walk in during visiting hours and ask for him by his full name. He deserves that.
